name: Box
usage: Local background blocks, scrollable areas, padding around a group of content

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on all sides, as a spacing step.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal padding, as a spacing step (overrides the left and right of `padding`).

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical padding, as a spacing step (overrides the top and bottom of `padding`).

props.name: surface
props.description:
Background surface: `canvas`, `surface` (panel), `sunken` (input backgrounds, table headers) or `elevated`
(overlays).

props.name: border
props.description:
Shows a hairline border. Hierarchy comes from backgrounds: separate blocks with `surface`, and use a border
only where an outline is really needed, such as drop zones and placeholders.

props.name: grow
props.description: Takes up the remaining space in a parent Stack or Inline.

props.name: scroll
props.description: Scrolls inside this container when the content overflows.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: A block with a background, rounded corners and padding.
